import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem bounded_finite_predecessor_connected_union {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {A : ℕ → Set X}
  {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hA : ∀ n, IsConnected (A n))
  (hPred : ∀ n, n < N → n ≠ 0 → (A n ∩ ⋃ k < n, A k).Nonempty) :
  IsConnected (⋃ k < N, A k) := by
  classical
  have hUnion : ∀ m, 0 < m → m ≤ N → IsConnected (⋃ k < m, A k) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        intro hm hle
        omega
    | succ n ih =>
        intro hm hle
        by_cases hn : n = 0
        · subst n
          simpa using hA 0
        · have hPrev : IsConnected (⋃ k < n, A k) :=
            ih (by omega) (by omega)
          have hOverlap : ((⋃ k < n, A k) ∩ A n).Nonempty := by
            simpa [Set.inter_comm] using hPred n (by omega) hn
          have hStep : IsConnected ((⋃ k < n, A k) ∪ A n) :=
            IsConnected.union hOverlap hPrev (hA n)
          have hEq : (⋃ k < n + 1, A k) = (⋃ k < n, A k) ∪ A n := by
            ext x
            simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_union]
            constructor
            · rintro ⟨k, hk, hx⟩
              by_cases hkn : k < n
              · exact Or.inl ⟨k, hkn, hx⟩
              · have hkeq : k = n := by omega
                exact Or.inr (hkeq ▸ hx)
            · rintro (⟨k, hk, hx⟩ | hx)
              · exact ⟨k, by omega, hx⟩
              · exact ⟨n, by omega, hx⟩
          rw [hEq]
          exact hStep
  exact hUnion N hN le_rfl

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem bounded_finite_predecessor_connected_union {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {A : ℕ → Set X}
  {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hA : ∀ n, IsConnected (A n))
  (hPred : ∀ n, n < N → n ≠ 0 → (A n ∩ ⋃ k < n, A k).Nonempty) :
  IsConnected (⋃ k < N, A k) := by
  induction N with
  | zero =>
      omega
  | succ N ih =>
      by_cases hzero : N = 0
      · subst N
        simpa using hA 0
      · have hprior : IsConnected (⋃ k < N, A k) := by
          apply ih
          · omega
          · intro n hn hne
            exact hPred n (by omega) hne
        have hinter : (A N ∩ ⋃ k < N, A k).Nonempty :=
          hPred N (by omega) hzero
        have hu : IsConnected (A N ∪ ⋃ k < N, A k) :=
          IsConnected.union hinter (hA N) hprior
        have heq : (⋃ k < N + 1, A k) = A N ∪ ⋃ k < N, A k := by
          ext x
          change (x ∈ ⋃ k < N + 1, A k) ↔
            (x ∈ A N ∨ x ∈ ⋃ k < N, A k)
          simp only [mem_iUnion]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨k, hk, hx⟩
            by_cases hek : k = N
            · exact Or.inl (hek ▸ hx)
            · exact Or.inr ⟨k, by omega, hx⟩
          · rintro (hx | ⟨k, hk, hx⟩)
            · exact ⟨N, by omega, hx⟩
            · exact ⟨k, by omega, hx⟩
        rw [← heq] at hu
        exact hu
